contexts.text: I have been surrounded by evil Spirits, sometimes by thousands of them.
When sent to others (the celestial Angels) are surrounded by other Angels...
[Swedenborg footnote 1.] A spiritual sphere surrounds everyone. References. AE 1076:3.
When the Lord appears in the midst of the Angels, He does not appear surrounded by many...
The things which emane from him surround him.
This is universal: that each thing is surrounded by something like that which is within it...
This sphere surrounds a man... thinly behind, but densely on the breast. CL 224.
